stem.en: So strong ___ that several trees were pulled out of the ground.

why.en: When 'So + adjective' starts the sentence, the verb comes before the subject: So strong was the wind that …
why.uz: Gap «So + sifat» bilan boshlansa, feʼl egadan oldin keladi: «So strong was the wind that …».
why.ru: Если предложение начинается с «So + прилагательное», глагол стоит перед подлежащим: «So strong was the wind that …».

stem.en: We regret ___ you that your application has not been successful.

why.en: 'Regret + to-infinitive' announces bad news now; 'regret + -ing' means being sorry about a past action.
why.uz: «Regret + to-infinitive» hozir yomon xabar berishda, «regret + -ing» esa oʻtmishdagi ishdan afsuslanishda ishlatiladi.
why.ru: «Regret + инфинитив с to» — сообщить плохую новость сейчас; «regret + -ing» — сожалеть о сделанном.

stem.en: Only if every member agrees ___.

why.en: 'Only if' at the start of a sentence causes inversion in the main clause: can the rules be changed.
why.uz: Gap boshidagi «Only if» bosh gapda inversiyaga olib keladi: can the rules be changed.
why.ru: «Only if» в начале предложения вызывает инверсию в главной части: can the rules be changed.

why.en: 'If + were to + verb' presents an imagined future event: If the government were to raise …

why.ru: «If + were to + глагол» описывает воображаемое будущее событие: «If the government were to raise …».

why.ru: Причастный оборот может заменить пассивное придаточное: Built in 1890 = which was built in 1890.

stem.en:
Nilufar agreed to lead the project, albeit reluctantly, since no one else on the team had any experience of managing a budget.
Why did Nilufar accept the role?

options.en: Nobody else had the right experience.
She was eager to take charge of a team at last.
Her manager ordered her to do it against her will.
She hoped the role would bring a higher salary.

why.en: 'Since no one else … had any experience' gives the reason; 'reluctantly' shows she was not eager.
why.uz: Sabab — boshqa hech kimda tajriba yoʻqligi; «reluctantly» uning istamay rozi boʻlganini koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Причина — ни у кого больше не было опыта; «reluctantly» показывает, что она согласилась неохотно.

stem.en:
The forecast had promised sunshine, so the hikers set off without coats, a decision several of them regretted by mid-afternoon.
What can we infer?

options.en: The weather turned worse than expected.
The hikers had read the forecast for the wrong day.
The hikers decided to turn back well before noon.
The forecast turned out to be completely accurate.

why.en: They regretted having no coats, which implies the weather got worse despite the forecast.
why.uz: Ular palto olmaganidan afsuslangan — demak, ob-havo prognozdagidan yomonlashgan.
why.ru: Они пожалели, что не взяли куртки, значит, погода испортилась вопреки прогнозу.

stem.en:
Few of the students had heard of the poet before the course, but by the end most counted her among their favourites.
What changed during the course?

options.en: She became a favourite poet for most of the class.
Most students found her poems harder than they expected.
Most students learned to write poems in her style.
Students who once admired her grew tired of her work.

why.en: Few knew her at first, but by the end most 'counted her among their favourites'; nothing is said about difficulty or about writing in her style.
why.uz: Boshida uni kam kishi bilgan, oxirida esa koʻpchilik uni sevimli shoirlari qatoriga qoʻshgan; qiyinlik yoki uning uslubida yozish haqida gap yoʻq.
why.ru: Сначала её мало кто знал, а к концу большинство причисляло её к любимым поэтам; о трудности стихов или подражании её стилю не сказано.

stem.en:
The bridge will remain open during repairs, but drivers are warned to expect delays of up to forty minutes at peak times.
What does the text say about the repairs?

options.en: They may cause long delays at the busiest times.
They may close the bridge for up to forty minutes.
They may cause delays, mainly during the night.
They may take up to forty days to finish.

why.en: The bridge 'will remain open', but drivers should 'expect delays of up to forty minutes at peak times'; no closure, night work or finishing date is given.
why.uz: Koʻprik ochiq qoladi, lekin tigʻiz paytlarda qirq daqiqagacha kutish mumkin; yopilish, tungi ish yoki tugash muddati aytilmagan.
why.ru: Мост остаётся открытым, но в часы пик возможны задержки до сорока минут; о закрытии, ночных работах или сроке окончания не сказано.
